out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: OBSERVED TWO SHEET PANS OF COOLING NOODLES IN THE WALK-IN COOLER TIGHTLY WRAPPED WITH PLASTIC WRAP.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EHS REVIEWED PROPER COOLING METHODS WITH THE PIC. PLEASE ENSURE FOODS ARE NOT TIGHTLY WRAPPED WITH PLASTIC UNTIL THEY ARE PROPERLY COOLED.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: OBSERVED VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS IN CONTAINERS STORED IN THE FLOOR OF THE WALK-IN COOLER AND WALK-IN FREEZER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PLEASE ENSURE ALL FOOD ITEMS ARE ELEVATED OFF THE GROUND TO PREVENT CROSS CONTAMINATION AND ALLOW FOR EASY CLEANING.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: KETCHUP AND GROUND BEAN SAUCE MANUFACTURER CANS WERE OBSERVED IN SOME BULK CONTAINERS AND AT THE COOK-LINE FOR WATER.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PLEASE DISCONTINUE USING THESE CONTAINERS AS THEY ARE NOT NSF-APPROVED/DURABLE AND ARE NOT MEANT TO BE WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED REPEATEDLY.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW SHELLED EGGS, SHRIMP, AND CHICKEN STORED ABOVE PRODUCE IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC REORGANIZED COOLER DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE RAW FOODS ARE ALWAYS STORED BELOW ANY COOKED OR READY TO EAT FOODS AND ORGANIZED BASED ON COOK TEMPERATURE.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED VARIOUS CONTAINERS/BOTTLES WITHOUT A LABEL.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PLEASE ENSURE ALL FOOD ITEMS NOT IN ITS ORIGINAL CONTAINER HAVE A LABEL.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: OBSERVED EQUIPMENT AT THE COOK-LINE IN NEED OF CLEANING DUE TO ACCUMULATION OF GRIME.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PLEASE ENSURE COOK-LINE EQUIPMENT IS THOROUGHLY CLEANED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the FLOORS THROUGHOUT THE BACK KITCHEN (ESPECIALLY UNDER THE COOK-LINE AND PLUMBING) is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PLEASE ENSURE FLOORS ARE CLEANED THOROUGHLY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE AND ON A FREQUENT BASIS TO PREVENT GRIME ACCUMULATION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink in the back kitchen WITH A LARGE POT AND NETTING IN THE SINK BASIN.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC REMOVED ITEMS FROM SINK DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS HANDWASHING SINKS SHOULD ONLY BE USED FOR HANDWASHING AND SHOULD ALWAYS BE ACCESSIBLE.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at handwashing sink IN BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC ADDED TOWELS DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS HANDWASHING SINKS SHOULD ALWAYS BE PROPERLY SUPPLIED.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: OBSERVED CARDBOARD LINING SHELVES AND EQUIPMENT THROUGHOUT BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. PIC UNDERSTANDS CARDBOARD SHOULD NOT BE USED AS IT IS NOT NON-ABSORBENT. PLEASE USE PLEXIGLASS OR OTHER NONABSORBENT MATERIALS.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' NO EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY OBSERVED AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS PROVIDED COPY TO PIC. PLEASE REVIEW WITH EMPLOYEES AND HAVE EACH EMPLOYEE SIGN A COPY. MAINTAIN SIGNED COPIES ON SITE FOR REVIEW BY THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: POOLED EGGS AT 57F ON CART NEAR WOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC WILL USE TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL FOR POOLED EGGS. EHS WILL FORWARD DOCUMENTATION TO PIC.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Clean Utensils Storage and Handling
violations.observation: OBSERVED CLEAN KITCHENWARE AND UTENSILS STORED ON DRAIN BOARD OF 3 COMPARTMENT SINK WHILE EMPLOYEE WAS PREPARING RAW BEEF IN THE SANITIZING COMPARTMENT OF THE SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items and cleaned/sanitized utensils shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of food and lip contact surfaces are prevented. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REMOVE KITCHENWARE AND UTENSILS TO BE RE-CLEANED AND SANITIZED AFTER PREPARATION OF RAW BEEF IS COMPLETED. THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK MUST BE CLEANED AND SANITIZED BEFORE RETURNING KITCHENWARE FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING.
